title: Eleven Meetings and One Bridge
subtitle: 灾害应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 灾害应对（灾害防范·灾害与应对）
meta: 主题语境：灾害应对（灾害防范·灾害与应对）　|　核心词汇：opinion　|　正文 378 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 opinion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: After the flood the town held eleven meetings about the bridge, and every one of them ended with a vote nobody could explain. The engineer's ① opinion was that the old piles would hold; the county's consultant gave a second ② opinion that said they would not; and between the two the council discovered that public ③ opinion is not a thing you can pour concrete into. I was at nine of the meetings, and what I remember is how little the word cost: everybody had an opinion about the piles and nobody had a pile.

④ In my opinion — and I said it out loud only once, in March, and was not thanked for it — the bridge was never the problem. The problem was the road behind it, built in 1974 on fill and not looked at since. I am ⑤ of the opinion that a town which argues about a bridge for eleven months has decided that something else is too expensive to think about. My father, who had a ⑥ high opinion of engineers and of this one in particular, told me to stop talking and start measuring.

So I measured. The road behind the bridge had sunk four inches on the north side and none on the south, which is the kind of number that ends an argument rather than starting one. At the tenth meeting I put it on the board and sat down. The engineer asked for the ⑦ opinion of the room, and the room, having no opinion left of its own, voted for the road.

Whether the piles would have held is now, and will remain, ⑧ a matter of opinion, because they were pulled out in April and taken away on a lorry before anybody thought to test them. That is the part I mind: not that we were wrong, but that we shall never know. It is my ⑨ opinion that a town ought to keep the things it is wrong about, stacked somewhere, the way a library keeps the books nobody borrows.

The new bridge opened in June and is, by common consent, ugly. Whether it is also safe is a question my ⑩ opinion on bridges is not qualified to answer. I go over it twice a week and I do not slow down.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 意见；看法；主张
B. n. 舆论；公众的意见（public opinion）
C. n. （专家的）鉴定意见；专业判断（a second opinion）
D. 固定搭配：in one's opinion 在某人看来
E. 固定搭配：be of the opinion that 认为；持……的看法
F. 固定搭配：a matter of opinion 见仁见智的事
G. 固定搭配：have a high opinion of 对……评价很高
H. 固定搭配：one's opinion on sth. 对某事的意见

items.q: The engineer's opinion was that the old piles would hold
the county's consultant gave a second opinion that said they would not
public opinion is not a thing you can pour concrete into
I am of the opinion that a town which argues about a bridge
It is my opinion that a town ought to keep

answers.why: 指工程师个人的“意见、看法”，即他认为旧桥桩还能撑住。
a second opinion 指“第二份（专家）鉴定意见”，即县里顾问给出的相反判断。
public opinion 意为“舆论、公众意见”，说它不是能浇筑进混凝土里的东西。
in my opinion 意为“在我看来”，引出作者自己的判断。
be of the opinion that 意为“认为、持……的看法”，是较正式的书面表达。
have a high opinion of 意为“对……评价很高”，说父亲很看重工程师。
the opinion of the room 指“在场众人的意见”，此处取“意见、看法”。
a matter of opinion 意为“见仁见智的事”，说桥桩究竟撑不撑得住永远无法证实。
It is my opinion that 仍是“我的看法是……”，取“意见、主张”义。
one's opinion on sth. 意为“对某事的意见”，说自己没有资格评判新桥。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 工程师认为旧桥桩还能撑住。（opinion）

The county's consultant gave a second opinion.
